# Isaiah Chapter 38 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 22 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Fifteen years added; sundial sign; Hezekiah's psalm of thanksgiving; life from the pit*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Hezekiah's Illness:** Fifteen years added; sundial sign; Hezekiah's psalm of thanksgiving; life from the pit. The key message for modern readers: "I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul"

*-- PNEUMA*
